instruction: Follow up with Dana about the proposal if she hasn't replied.
final_text:
I've followed up with Dana. She hadn't replied to your "Northwind proposal" email from Wed 23 Sep. I checked your whole mailbox and found nothing from her since then.

I sent the follow-up in the same thread to dana@pinecrest.example:

> Hi Dana,
>
> Just following up on the proposal I sent over last week: https://docs.northwind.example/pinecrest-proposal
>
> Do you have any questions, or any thoughts so far? I'm still happy to walk your team through it. Just let me know a time that works.
>
> Best,
> Sam

I also set a reminder for Tue 6 Oct. If she still hasn't replied by then, the thread will come back to the top of your inbox.
